title: Can I Use Multiple Websites on Divi?
raw_text:
Can I Use Multiple Websites on Divi?
## Overview
Yes! You are free to create multiple websites with your Developer or Lifetime Account. It is one of the many perks of being an Elegant Themes Customer. 😃
Once you are an Elegant Themes customer you will be able to create API keys used to get automatic updates right inside your WordPress Dashboard. ​ ​ Note: You are free to use the same API key on multiple websites.
